opportunities.name_zh: Reflection Lakes・Mount Rainier清晨鏡面倒影
opportunities.best_time: 清晨低風時優先；車輛通常僅夏季可由Stevens Canyon Road抵達
opportunities.best_season: 典型車輛季為6月底至9月；實際道路狀態必須以NPS即時資訊為準

condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"Reflection Lakes Camera Zone","target":"Mount Rainier mirrored in still lake"}

viewpoints.geometry_note: Reflection Lakes停車／合法步道周邊；必須留在正式步道以保護高山草甸。

opportunities.name_zh: Tipsoo Lake・Mount Rainier日出暖光與湖面倒影
opportunities.best_time: 日出前後；SR410／Tipsoo Lake實際開放期間
opportunities.best_season: 車輛通常6–10月可達；實際季節道路狀態優先

condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"Tipsoo Lake Camera Zone","target":"warm sunrise on Mount Rainier + lake reflection"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: SR410與Tipsoo Lake實際可達；日出時段有效；不得離開步道／下水
condition_variants.required_conditions: Rainier可辨；晨光時段有效；能見度足夠；低雲／降水未完全遮蔽山體

condition_variants.penalties: 冬季道路關閉；濃霧／低雲遮山；強降水；水面不平靜時降低倒影品質

viewpoints.note: NPS identifies Tipsoo Lake as a Scenic View/Photo Spot; the official park brochure directly documents a sunrise-lit Mount Rainier mirror reflection. Vehicle access is seasonal.

viewpoints.geometry_note: Tipsoo Lake環湖正式步道與停車周邊；禁止涉水並應保護高山草甸。
